title: My Grace Is Enough
story:
A young girl wanted to learn how to swim.

At first, she was afraid to let go of the side of the pool.

She watched other children swim confidently, but she felt that she was not strong enough.

Her instructor stayed beside her and said, "You don't have to do this by yourself. I am here to help you."

Little by little, the girl learned to trust the instructor.

She still felt nervous, but she discovered that she did not need to be strong in every moment.

She needed to trust the one who was helping her.

Sometimes we also face situations where we feel weak, inadequate, or unable to continue.

We may wish that God would simply remove every difficulty.

But sometimes God works differently.

Instead of removing the weakness immediately, He gives us His grace to walk through it.

His power is made perfect when we recognize our weakness and depend on Him.

We do not have to hide our weaknesses from God.

We can bring them to Him and discover that His grace is enough for us.
life_lesson: You do not have to be strong in your own strength. God's grace is sufficient, and His power can work through your weaknesses.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You that Your grace is sufficient for me.

When I feel weak, inadequate, or unable to continue, help me to depend on You instead of my own strength.

Teach me not to be ashamed of my weaknesses but to bring them honestly before You.

Let Your power work through my life, especially in the areas where I feel weakest.

Give me the faith to trust that Your grace is enough for every situation I face.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What weakness are you struggling with right now?

Are you trying to overcome it through your own strength?

How can you depend on God's grace and power today?
verse: My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness.
